current_rule.who: Steward chooses subsequent work after any ended attempt, except the recovery coordinator role may choose replacement work.
exception_conditions: an already approved performance-investigation plan exists
the chooser is acting as recovery coordinator, not as orchestrator
the work chosen is replacement work within that plan
current_rule.outside_exception: Steward still chooses subsequent work; no general orchestrator bypass is granted.
current_rule.excerpt: with one bounded exception: within an already approved performance-investigation plan, the recovery coordinator may choose replacement work after a failed attempt
